newsitem.title: FRANCE: Italian named new head of Euro space agency.
newsitem.headline: Italian named new head of Euro space agency.

text.p: Italian Antonio Rodota was on Thursday appointed director-general of the European Space Agency (ESA), replacing Frenchman Jean-Marie Luton who is not seeking a third term of office, ESA said.

Rodota, 61, was appointed for four years by the agency's council which represents member states. ESA has sharply reduced major programmes for the coming years due to budget cuts by the countries involved.

The new director-general is currently director of the Space Division of the Italian firm Finemeccannica, managing director of Quadrics Supercomputer World Ltd and a director of several companies including Arianespace which makes the European Ariane space rocket.
